setup.text: Toby measures a scoop of flour, frowns, and scrapes it back into the sack. "Dough went flat overnight. If the whole square turns out, we're forty loaves short."

option_a.text: The player brings a skin of spring water over to the starter bowl. Toby glances at the vessel, says nothing, and works the liquid into the starter without breaking stride.

option_b.text: The player casts weigh over the flour sack. Toby reads the number off the air, mutters the new total, and keeps working. "Thirteen and a bit. Two more after hers."

option_c.text:
"Need a hand?"

Toby hesitates a half-beat. "Not yet."
